name: C'tan Shard
equipped_with: A C'tan Shard is equipped with: Fists of a Star God.

weapons.name: Gaze of Death
weapons.abilities: Auto Hit, Blood Drinker, Poison(2+), Suppression(6)

abilities: Anti-Grav, Mindless, Regeneration(1), Terrifying(-1)

Immune to Natural Law: When moving, this model treats all other models and terrain as open ground, allowing it to move freely over them. It automatically passes all dangerous terrain tests. However, it cannot end its move on top of another model and may only end its move on impassable terrain if the model can physically be placed there.
Necrodermis: The model gains a 4+ ward save. If it loses its last wound, it explodes like a vehicle with Strength 7 and AP -1.
Powers of the C'tan: The model can manifest 1 power per turn automatically. It knows all powers from the list of C'tan powers. A C'tan can only use each power once per battle round.
Cosmic Tyrant: The model may manifest another power per turn.
Dread: Enemy units within 12" suffer -2 to their Leadership.
Entropic Touch: The model gains the "Shred" ability for all melee attacks.
Gaze of Death: The model gains the "Gaze of Death" weapon.
Grand Illusion: At the beginning of the first battle round, you can remove up to three of your units from the field and redeploy them. Alternatively, each unit can also be placed in reserve.
Hardened Necrodermis: The model gains a 3+ armor save.
Infinite Recursion: The model may manifest a power it already used this turn a second time.
Matter Absorption: The model restores all lost Wounds if it kills a vehicle.
Misdirect: The model gains the "Deflect", "Hit & Run" and "Parry" abilities.
Scythe of the Nightbringer: The model gains the "Scythe of the Nightbringer" weapon. Replaces "Fists of a Star God".
Seismic Assault: The model gains the "Seismic Assault" weapon.
Sentient Necrodermis: The model gains the "Regeneration(2)" ability.
Spear of the Dragon: The model gains the "Spear of the Dragon" weapon. Replaces "Fists of a Star God".
Transdimensional Displacement: The model automatically advances 6" instead of rolling for it
Untamed Power: The model gains +1 Strength and +1 Attack.
Voltaic Storm: The model gains the "Voltaic Storm" weapon.
Writhing Worldscape: All terrain within 6" of the model is treated as difficult and dangerous terrain for enemy units.
